kevin: hey all, brand new here. finishing bootstrap on WSL2 Ubuntu. hit a weird one: asdf installs hang on tar extraction and pipenv fails to create virtualenvs. any quick ideas?

tori: welcome! paste the errors?

kevin: asdf shows `tar: Unexpected EOF in archive` when getting python tarball. pipenv says `virtualenv is not available` after pip install.

tori: tar EOF often means proxy or corrupt download. check http_proxy/https_proxy in env and try curl the tarball directly. For pipenv, make sure `python3-venv` or `virtualenv` is installed: `sudo apt install python3-venv virtualenv`.

kevin: removed proxy env (was set by Docker Desktop), curl gave a clean tarball. installing python3-venv fixed pipenv. two tiny gotchas that might help others: 1) add `NO_PROXY=download.python.org,files.pythonhosted.org` to avoid proxy for python assets; 2) on WSL add `export LANG=C.UTF-8` to avoid pip decoding errors.

infra-bot: INF-5314 created to add NO_PROXY and LANG notes to WSL bootstrap docs (assigned eng-infra).

kevin: sweet, all green now. thanks for the quick help :party:
